title: Daily Dose #372: Establish the Work
body:
**“Establish the work of our hands upon us.”**

We can fill our days with activity and still wonder whether any of it will last.

Psalm 90 places human life beside the eternity of God. Our years are brief, our strength is limited and even our best work can disappear. Moses therefore asks God to establish—to give lasting value to—the work of His people.

This prayer humbles both ambition and insecurity. We cannot make our work permanent through effort alone. At the same time, ordinary work offered to God is not meaningless. He can use a task, conversation, act of service or faithful decision in ways we may never fully see.

Ask God to direct what you do today. Work carefully and honestly. Then release the need to guarantee its importance.

Our hands are temporary. God can give their work lasting purpose.
